attributes.action: Call upon urgent government action on the crisis in Azad Jammu and Kashmir(AJK)
attributes.additional_details:
Since June 5, 2026, unrest in Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK), Pakistan, has escalated after the government blocked roads, suspended internet and phone services, and restricted media access ahead of a June 9 strike organised by the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC). At least 24 people have been killed and hundreds injured. The conflict reflects long-standing grievances over resource distribution, political representation, and regional autonomy. 
Local residents have for years raised concerns over rising inflation, electricity pricing and unemployment.
attributes.background: 1.Take a proactive diplomatic role with all relevant parties to help de-escalate tensions and support a peaceful resolution to the conflict 2.Press for the immediate restoration of communication services including internet and phone-3.Support investigations into alleged human rights violations.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Raise Human Rights Issues in Azad Kashmir with the Government of Pakistan" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/772026

You may be interested in the Government response to that petition, which sets out the action the Government has already taken.
